name: pinterest-publishing
description: Check this pasted RSS feed and tell me why Pinterest won't turn my articles into Pins. Use when articles do not become Pins, a feed returns an error, or you need item-level fixes and a native setup checklist. Review pasted XML, exports, and screenshots described by you. Explain supported formats, claimed-domain links, image fields, publishing delays, and board visibility. Guide Pinterest native RSS setup without account access. Not for product catalogs, other social networks, scraping, or third-party publishing services.
